input.summary: Upper porch lit: 0 dark cells, every standable floor cell at 8+ (was min 6, 17 dim). Added 3 standing lanterns on the deck at (28,11,41), (67,11,41) and (47,11,39), placed into air only; parts/room-28.mjs is the only file touched.
left: Lamp-post spacing confirmed: the z38 posts at x30, 39, 56, 65 (dark oak fence at y11, standing lantern at y12) stand on the merged spruce deck (y10, z36..41 verified at x30, z38). Spacing 9/8/9/9 with the table lantern at x47, inside the 8-10 target. The fence post is one cell (1.5 high), so the lantern top sits below the rail.

Balustrade height: birch fence y11 plus smooth_quartz_slab top at y12 gives a rail top at y13, two blocks above the deck. Lamp tops are below it. Whether two blocks is the right rail height is the designer's call; I did not change it.

Hanging lanterns on the centre line are already there, not missing: colonnade.mjs calls porchLantern(g, 47, 16, 38), so an iron_chain at (47,16,38) hangs a lantern at (47,15,38) under the y17 ceiling. I did not add another. Recommend keeping this single chain lantern as the gallery's one hanging light. Adding more on x47 would stack three lights on the axis.

The lantern at (47,11,39) sits on the door axis between the upper door and the focal barrel table. It blocks one of the two axis cells; walk is unchanged (272 of 290 reachable, same as before). If the designer wants the axis clear, the alternative is a pair at (44,11,41) and (51,11,41), which costs one more lamp.

The 4 remaining dim cells (x34, x35, x60, x61 at z35) are birch fence cells on the balustrade, not standable floor, so the room check's dim count of 4 is not a dark or dim floor problem. The suggestion list's (30,13,35) and (56,13,35) points are also rail cells, not standable; ignored.

waste.what: Worked out which dim cells were standable: the light grid counts birch fence and rail cells as floor, so 4 of the 8 dim cells and the 30,13,35 / 56,13,35 suggestions were not places a player can stand. I verified each cell by probe.
waste.cost: about 6 probe calls, plus an awk pass to turn the text light grid into coordinates (the grid's x offset was off by one, so I had to correct it by hand)
waste.tool: mcd light --json (or --cells) listing each dim/dark cell as x,y,z with a standable flag that excludes fences, slabs, furniture; and suggested lamps that avoid rail rows

waste.what: No single-block query: I wrote /tmp/lamp-probe-35/probe.mjs (load() plus g.get over a box) to read blocks and states.
waste.tool: mcd cells build.nbt x0,y0,z0 x1,y1,z1 (non-air blocks with state)

waste.what: The lamp suggestion list is not mirror-aware: it proposed 66,11,41 when the room's mirror partner of 28 is 67 (axis 47.5). I used 67 by hand and re-verified.
waste.cost: one hand-computed mirror and a re-run
waste.tool: mcd light suggestions honouring the room's symmetry axis (AXIS_X 47.5), e.g. --mirror-x 47.5

waste.what: Each candidate lamp needed a full make.sh rebuild (the whole 40-part build) before the light could be read.
waste.tool: mcd room --overlay 'lantern@28,11,41;...' to test candidate lamps against the built grid without rebuilding
